SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   D. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   C. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   C. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   D. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   B. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   D. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

15. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   D. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
